title: Signed strict exact sequence of the right principal Koszul tensor tower
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site essentially small in the coefficient universe, $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings, $t$ a global section, and $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ with sheafification [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Form the right total tensor tower $V(Q)_m=Q\otimes L_{m+1}$, where $L_{m+1}=\operatorname{Cone}(t^{m+1}:R[0]\to R[0])$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves, def-pur-principal-koszul-quotient-towers]. There are a functor $Z$ on all unbounded cochain complexes $Q$, natural maps $i:\operatorname{const}(Q)\to V(Q)$ and $p:V(Q)\to Z(Q)$ with $ip=0$, level isomorphisms $\zeta_{Q,m}:Z(Q)_m\cong Q[1]$, and isomorphisms $\chi_{Q,m,k}:V(Q)_m^k\cong Q^k\oplus Q^{k+1}$. The inverse of $\chi$ is exactly the sum of the two total tensor inclusions, using the right unitor and the degree-zero target and degree-minus-one source of the cone. The sequence $0\to\operatorname{const}(Q)\xrightarrow{i}V(Q)\xrightarrow{p}Z(Q)\to0$ is short exact. In these coordinates $i(x)=(x,0)$, $p(x,y)=(-1)^ky$, $d(x,y)=(dx+(-1)^{k+1}t^{m+1}y,dy)$, the transition of $V$ is $(x,y)\mapsto(x,ty)$, and the transition of $Z$, transported through $\zeta$ and the canonical shift coordinates, is multiplication by $t$. No exactness of products, derived category, nilpotence, or boundedness assumption is required.

proof.text: Write $V_j=Q\otimes_RL_j$. By the total-tensor convention, only the summands $Q^k\otimes R$ and $Q^{k+1}\otimes R$ occur in degree $k$, so $V_j^k=Q^k\oplus Q^{k+1}$ and $d(x,y)=(dx+(-1)^{k+1}t^jy,dy)$. In particular $d^2=0$: the two mixed terms have coefficients $(-1)^{k+1}+(-1)^{k+2}=0$, and $d$ commutes with the scalar $t^j$. The inclusion $i_j(x)=(x,0)$ is a chain map. The map $p_j^k(x,y)=(-1)^ky$ is a chain map to $Q[1]$, since $p_j^{k+1}d(x,y)=(-1)^{k+1}dy=-d_Q((-1)^ky)$. Its kernel is exactly the first summand, and its degreewise section is $z\mapsto(0,(-1)^kz)$. Thus $0\to Q\xrightarrow{i_j}V_j\xrightarrow{p_j}Q[1]\to0$ is degreewise split exact.

proof.text: The Koszul transition on these coordinates is $a_j(x,y)=(x,ty)$. It is a chain map because $t^j(ty)=t^{j+1}y$; furthermore $a_ji_{j+1}=i_j$ and $p_ja_j=t p_{j+1}$. These equations give the asserted strict short exact sequence $0\to\operatorname{const}(Q)\xrightarrow{i}V\xrightarrow{p}Z\to0$ of tower complexes, with $Z_j=Q[1]$ and transition $t$. The sections from step 1 need not be tower maps, and no such splitting is asserted.

proof.text: For a chain map b, the total tensor map acts as (b^k,b^(k+1)) on the two summands. Thus the displayed inclusion and signed projection commute with b, giving natural transformations on all complexes. All zero and invertible scalar cases obey the same formulas.

theorem nilpotentKoszulCoordinates
    (t : (SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj
      R)).sections) :
    ∃ (Z : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ ⥤ CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤
      (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R))) ℤ)
      (ζ : ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ),
        (Z.obj Q).asFunctor.obj (op m) ≅ Q⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (i : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ : (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ⥤ (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ (ringedSiteModules.{r}
      ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)))).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⟶ spKoszulRightTower R t)
      (p : spKoszulRightTower R t ⟶ Z)
      (hi : i ≫ p = 0)
      (χ : ∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
        (((spKoszulRightTower R t).obj Q).X k).obj (op m) ≅ Q.X k ⊞ Q.X (k + 1)),
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
        (χ Q m k).inv = spKoszulRightCoordinatesInv R t Q m k) ∧
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ),
        (ShortComplex.mk (i.app Q) (p.app Q) (NatTrans.congr_app hi Q)).ShortExact) ∧
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
        ((i.app Q).f k).app (op m) ≫ (χ Q m k).hom = biprod.inl) ∧
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
        ((p.app Q).f k).app (op m) ≫ (ζ Q m).hom.f k ≫
          (Q.shiftFunctorObjXIso (1 : ℤ) k (k + 1) rfl).hom =
        (χ Q m k).hom ≫ (k.negOnePow • biprod.snd)) ∧
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
        (((spKoszulRightTower R t).obj Q).d k (k + 1)).app (op m) ≫
            (χ Q m (k + 1)).hom =
          (χ Q m k).hom ≫ biprod.desc
            (Q.d k (k + 1) ≫ biprod.inl)
            (((k + 1).negOnePow •
                endoPow (spKoszulScalar R t (Q.X (k + 1))) (m + 1)) ≫ biprod.inl +
              Q.d (k + 1) ((k + 1) + 1) ≫ biprod.inr)) ∧
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
        (((spKoszulRightTower R t).obj Q).X k).map
            (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)).op ≫ (χ Q m k).hom =
          (χ Q (m + 1) k).hom ≫
            biprod.map (𝟙 _) (spKoszulScalar R t (Q.X (k + 1)))) ∧
      (∀ (Q : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{r} ((sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{r} RingCat.{r})).obj R)) ℤ) (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
        ((Z.obj Q).X k).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ m)).op ≫
            (ζ Q m).hom.f k ≫ (Q.shiftFunctorObjXIso (1 : ℤ) k (k + 1) rfl).hom =
          (ζ Q (m + 1)).hom.f k ≫
            (Q.shiftFunctorObjXIso (1 : ℤ) k (k + 1) rfl).hom ≫
              spKoszulScalar R t (Q.X (k + 1)))
